title: Reports
no_org: Open an organization to see its reports.
about_configured: Each report is configured once for the organization: where its board and its plan come from. Everyone who opens it reads the same.
about_refresh: Refresh reads the plan again and syncs the board; switched on, a schedule does the same every hour.
refresh_hint: Read the plan again and sync the board
refresh_blocked: Name the board, a plan file, or upload the plan first
definition_error: The plan's own definition does not read: {error}
uploaded_in_use: an uploaded plan is in use
consumers_placeholder: A=Acronis, C=Constructor — or `consumers:` in the plan
plan_carries: The plan can carry everything but the connection:
plan_carries_end: or a definition of its own.
edit_plan: Edit the plan: teams, people, projects, needs…
still_running: still running — look under Background work
hourly_off: No longer refreshes on its own.
kpi_not_on_board_sub: catalogued, unplanned: pin one through its Roadmap item field
no_gears_title: No gears on the board yet.
no_gears_body: Set the report's source under Reports and refresh it.
col_p1_off_track_hint: P1 demand whose plan is at risk or needs a check
publish_teams: Publish teams to the Studio domain model
publish_teams_hint: Mirror the units, teams, people and their shares into the Studio domain model, so the rest of Studio sees them. Saving teams or people does this on its own.
plan_none: No plan yet: start it here, or load gears.yaml above.
plan_read_from: Read from {file}: the first save here lets the file go.
plan_confirm_home: The plan is read from {file}. Saving here makes Studio its home, and refreshes stop reading the file. Save?
plan_stale: Somebody saved the plan since you opened it. Reload to see their change; what you typed here is lost on reload.
no_unit_colour: Colour of a person in no unit
people_filter: Filter by login, alias or team
link_member_hint: An active member, by their confirmed GitHub account
link_outsider_hint: A Studio person by this GitHub account, but not a member of this organization
link_unknown_hint: Nobody in Studio has confirmed this GitHub account
link_unsaved_hint: Matched once the people are saved
unplanned_members: Members of the organization the plan does not list:
members_without_github_one: {count} member has no confirmed GitHub account, so the plan cannot name them until they confirm one.
members_without_github_many: {count} members have no confirmed GitHub account, so the plan cannot name them until they confirm one.
projects_order_hint: The order here is the order of the needs' columns in the workbook.
needs_hint: A cell is when the project needs the gear: a quarter (Q3'26), YES (already), no, or ?. Empty means not asked.
lanes_hint: A group is the prefix of a gear's title on the board ("CORE - …"). Groups not listed come after these.
